title: Miserable condition of Panathur-Belagere Road Railway Underpass
description:
Panathur, due to its proximity to Whitefield and Sarjapura, has seen rapid growth in the last 2 years and is now filled with commercial properties and apartment complexes. Sobha Dream Acres, a massive undertaking on the Panathur-Belagere Road, has 6500 flats. Prestige Lake View, another apartment complex, has around 4000 flats to its name. All told there should be more than 15000 flats. 
Being extremely narrow, this road can barely handle two-way traffic. It is filled with garbage and potholes and is perpetually being dug up on some pretext. The icing on the cake is a narrow railway vent at the end of this stretch which allows only one-way traffic to commute at a time. 
The menace on the Panathur-Belagere Road begins even before sunrise at times and continues for the rest of the day. Over 20,000 vehicles pass through this road daily where only one side is let to travel at a time. The presence of a large number of water tankers only adds to the chaos as these tanker drivers rush along with a complete disregard for traffic or rules. 
Making matters worse, the traffic on the Panathur-Belagere Road is not being managed by the city’s traffic police. This Herculean task falls to private security guards deployed by some IT companies.  Many people don’t conform to the guard’s instructions as they have no legal power to penalize anyone. 
The residents of Panathur have been waiting for years, in suspended animation, hoping to see a ray of light in what seems to be a never-ending tunnel of darkness.

title: Outer ring road is swept but the mud/sand etc is not picked up, instead left in mounds, along the roads, medians , on footpaths etc
description:
2 months back, i took a ride from Bellandur to Kalyan Nagar and back( I live in Bangalore ) with the specific intention of taking pictures along the outer ring road to capture the negligence of the authorities who are in charge of cleaning the roads in this stretch. In short here is what you see:
1) Mounds of sand/mud along the sides or medians of the ORR in many stretches including flyovers, maximum after the More flyover when going towards KR Puram station. These mounds are not natural formations, they have been made by someone, quite obvious by the people who have swept the road, perhaps with the intention that it would be picked up by another team , but then that has not happened. These mounds of mud still exist in after a month!
2) You can see the same mounds of mud and sand on the top portion of flyover to Kasturinagar from Tin Factory. The mud and sand are neatly arranged as small mountains( kids might love to see them !! ) on the footpath. Again they exist till date!!
3) The state of underpasses at the center of the underpass right under the bridge on top, should be seen, mainly the Ram Murthy Nagar and Horamavu underpass. You can see lot of sand/mud on the side of the road along with lot of the same accumulated on the footpaths. If a two wheeler goes towards the side of the roads in speed, the rider is sure of getting the "last ride".
I can go on and on listing such stuff. The same scenes can be seen on Indiranagar 100 ft road, sarjapur road, old airport road etc. I fail to understand this!! When someone has swept the road, am sure some money would have paid for doing the same, why is the stuff not being picked up!! Instead it is left lying there, in fact you can see plants growing in many of these sand/mud mounds!!
Can't Bangalore have cleaner roads, is it that difficult? Many a times citizens add to the mess by throwing garbage on top of these mounds of sand/mud. Please stop doing this!!
I have not seen this state in any other city.
The idea of taking the pics was that reaches the concerned authorities and they take some action. Now, just uploading the photos( around 50 of them ) would have been very boring. So, i decided to make a video with the photos, along with an inspirational song.
It is more than 2 months now but absolutely nothing has been done till now.
